name: Dream Bough
summary: On an island in northern Feralas, green dragons guard Dream Bough. The ancient Great Tree shelters a gateway into the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: The Great Tree of Jademir
sections.body: Dream Bough rises above the forest on an island in Jademir Lake. It is the largest tree in northern Feralas. A natural portal opens in its trunk and leads straight into the untamed Emerald Dream.

sections.title: The Emerald Watchers
sections.body: The Green Dragonflight guards Dream Bough and the gateway in its trunk. Dragonkin and drakes patrol the lake’s banks and the approaches to the great tree. Druids come to contemplate and sleep as they pass between realms. Few uninvited travelers are tolerated near this threshold, so approach with care.

faq.answer: Dream Bough is a massive Great Tree on an island in Jademir Lake, in northern Feralas. A gateway in its trunk opens directly into the Emerald Dream.
No account from this age records who planted Dream Bough. The Great Tree shelters a gateway into the Emerald Dream, and the Green Dragonflight watches over it.

faq.q: Why are there green dragons here?
faq.answer: The Green Dragonflight guards the Emerald Dream. Since a direct gateway opens in Dream Bough’s trunk, dragons and their kin keep watch to protect it from intruders.

faq.q: Can players enter the portal into the Emerald Dream?
aliases: can i use dream bough portal
faq.answer: The portal in Dream Bough’s trunk opens into the Emerald Dream, but mortal adventurers awake in the physical realm cannot pass through it. Powerful sleeping druids and the Green Dragonflight cross freely.

angles.text: As a druid, you know Dream Bough as sacred ground, a living bridge between Azeroth’s wilderness and the Emerald Dream your order tends.
As a night elf, you can see in this great tree your people’s ancient duty to nurture and defend the natural world.
